_readme: THE MENU. This one file is the whole menu on the website.
TO CHANGE A PRICE:  find the number, type a new one. Prices are plain numbers, no $ sign.
TO ADD AN ITEM:     copy a whole { ... } line, paste it below, change the name and price.
TO REMOVE AN ITEM:  delete its whole { ... } line.
TO HIDE SOMETHING:  add  "hidden": true  to it instead of deleting (easy to put back).
several sizes  ->  "prices": [9.50, 12.90, 16.90, 20.95]  (matches the group's "sizes" list, in order)
no price yet   ->  "price": null   (shows as 'Call for price')
"tags" are the little labels + filters on the menu page. Use any of:
veg  spicy  seafood  chicken  donair  popular  new  glutenfree
Careful: every { } needs a comma after it EXCEPT the last one in a list.

builder._readme: Price by number of toppings. Row 0 = cheese only, row 1 = 1 topping, and so on. Row 5 is the Tasty Special.
_extraReadme: What each topping past the included count costs, per size.
The printed menu stops at five toppings, so a sixth has no published price.
These are the AVERAGE step between the menu's own topping prices (0.80 / 1.17 /
1.51 / 1.50), rounded. CONFIRM WITH THE SHOP before going live.
